title: The man who left everything unfinished
caption: Leonardo left half his paintings unfinished and filled thousands of pages with questions. Maybe he wasn't failing to finish. Maybe the questions mattered more. What's the question you'd write down today? Episode 1 of Explorers of the Mystery.
notes: Generated from: Three people who never solved the mystery of life and dove into it anyway: Leonardo da Vinci (notebooks, curiosity about everything), Anthony Bourdain (eating with strangers, travelling to meet people), Richard Feynman (the pleasure of finding things out, bongos, safecracking).
